modmenu.descriptionTranslation.deepmine: Digs a 1x4 tunnel as an outward spiral around a beacon while Haste II lasts. Silk Touch for ores, torches where it is dark, shulkers for the rubble.
deepmine.help.footer: All settings are saved automatically to config/deepmine.json.
deepmine.help.2.desc: pause, continue, show progress - resume also works after a restart or server change
deepmine.help.6.desc: blocks for holes in the floor, default 5
deepmine.help.8.desc: shulker in slot takes ... (repeat to add)
deepmine.help.14.desc: only full stacks into this shulker (default on for only-boxes)
deepmine.help.10.desc: default: 6 everything except cobbled deepslate, 7 only that
deepmine.help.11.desc: also mine with Silk Touch, default gravel
deepmine.start.on_pyramid: You are standing on the pyramid. Move at least %s blocks away from the beacon and start again.
deepmine.start.out_of_range: You are already out of range (%s > %s).
deepmine.start.ok: Started at beacon %s, radius %s, tunnel %s high. Abort with /deepmine stop.
deepmine.resume.nothing: Nothing to resume. Use /deepmine start first.
deepmine.resume.wrong_dimension: The job is in %s, you are in %s.
deepmine.resume.too_far: Next cell is at %s, you are %s blocks away. Stand in the tunnel in front of it, then /deepmine resume.
deepmine.config.slots: Pickaxe %s, Silk %s, Torches %s, Sword %s, Floor %s, Food %s, stop at %s durability.
deepmine.sword.off: No sword. Mobs will not be fought; only the health-below-12 stop protects you.
deepmine.sword.set: Sword in slot %s. Attackers will be fought.
deepmine.floor.off: No floor material. A hole under the next cell will stop the run.
deepmine.floor.set: Floor material in slot %s. Holes in the floor will be closed with it.
deepmine.food.off: No food slot. Hunger below 6 will stop the run.
deepmine.food.set: Food in slot %s. Eats at hunger 12.
deepmine.silk.cleared: Extra list cleared. Only ores with Silk Touch now.
deepmine.silk.added: %s will be mined with Silk Touch.
deepmine.box.all: Shulker in slot %s: everything (gear and other shulkers always stay out).
deepmine.box.fullstacks.on: Shulker in slot %s: only full stacks go in; started stacks stay until they are full.
deepmine.box.fullstacks.off: Shulker in slot %s: started stacks go in too.
deepmine.stop.inventory_full: Inventory full and no usable shulker left. Position %s. Continue with /deepmine resume.
deepmine.stop.hanging: A block is hanging above %s that does not fall.
deepmine.stop.out_of_reach: Target block %s is out of reach. Stand in the tunnel and use /deepmine resume.
deepmine.stop.sculk: Sculk at %s. Deep Dark, not digging further here.
deepmine.stop.stuck: Not making progress, stuck for 3 seconds at %s.
deepmine.stop.hole_no_slot: Hole under %s and no floor material configured. /deepmine floor <slot>, then /deepmine resume.
deepmine.stop.hole_empty: Hole under %s, but slot %s is empty. Refill, then /deepmine resume.
deepmine.stop.hole_blocked: Hole under %s, but the spot is taken (%s). Fix it by hand, then /deepmine resume.
deepmine.stop.hole_failed: Could not place the floor at %s.
deepmine.stop.hole_no_support: Nothing to place the floor against at %s.
deepmine.stop.eat_failed: Eating from slot %s does not work. Position %s. Continue with /deepmine resume.
deepmine.stop.losing_health: Losing health with no enemy in sight, health at %s.
deepmine.stop.no_regen: Health is not regenerating (out of food?). Health at %s.
deepmine.abort.hunger_no_slot: Hunger too low and no food slot (/deepmine food <slot>).
deepmine.abort.hunger_empty: Hunger too low and slot %s is empty.
deepmine.abort.no_haste: Haste II gone for 5 seconds, probably outside the beacon area.
deepmine.fight.timeout: Fight is taking too long, carrying on for now.
deepmine.store.done: Shulker (%s) picked back up: %s stacks, %s items inside.
deepmine.store.parked: Shulker at %s stays in place for now: nothing fits into it and the inventory is full. Trying the other box first.
deepmine.stop.parked: Inventory full and no box can take more. A filled shulker is still standing at %s. Make room, then /deepmine resume.
deepmine.store.no_space: No room to place the shulker
